definition_en: to keep something in your hand or in place, so that it does not move or leave
scene: 请人帮忙扶门，你说 Could you hold the door for a moment?
sceneCN: 这里 hold 是「扶住、使保持在原位」（第 2 个义项）；句意：你能帮忙扶一会儿门吗？

senses.title: Grasp: keep in the hand
senses.definition: to have something in your hand and not let it go
senses.definitionCN: 把某物握在手里，不让它掉
senses.example: She held the cup with both hands.
senses.why: The hand closes into a ring around the object. That ring is a frame, and the frame is what stops the object from falling or leaving.
senses.whyCN: 手握成一个环，把物体圈在中间。这个环就是'框'，框住它，东西才不会掉、不会走。

senses.title: Hold the door: keep in position
senses.definition: to keep something in a particular position, especially so it does not fall or close
senses.definitionCN: 使某物保持在某个位置，尤指不让它倒下或关上
senses.example: Can you hold the door for me?
senses.why: A door wants to swing shut; the hand takes over from the hinge and becomes the frame that fixes the position. Supporting is holding without grasping.
senses.whyCN: 门本来要自己关上；手代替了铰链，变成固定位置的'框'。'扶'是不用抓握的'握'。

senses.title: Contain: a bottle holds a litre
senses.definition: to have the capacity to contain something
senses.example: This bottle holds one litre of water.
senses.why: A container is a frame made of walls. What is inside is kept inside, so hold moves from the hand to the vessel, and then to the idea of capacity.
senses.whyCN: 容器是用壁做成的'框'，里面的东西被留在里面。于是 hold 从手转到容器，再转指容量。

senses.title: Hold back: restrain
senses.definition: to stop someone or something from moving forward, or to control a feeling
senses.definitionCN: 阻止某人或某物前进；抑制（情绪）
senses.example: The barrier held the crowd back.
senses.exampleCN: 护栏把人群挡在了后面。
senses.why: Here the frame pushes outward instead of enclosing: force is applied against movement. Holding back tears puts the same frame around a feeling.
senses.whyCN: 这里的'框'不是围住，而是向外推：力逆着运动方向使。'忍住眼泪'就是把同一个框套在情绪上。

senses.title: Hold someone: detain
senses.definition: to keep someone in custody or make them stay
senses.example: The police held him for questioning.
senses.why: A cell is a legal frame; the person is kept inside it. Custody is containment applied to a human being.
senses.whyCN: 牢房是法律意义上的'框'，人被留在框里。'拘留'就是把'容纳'用在人身上。

senses.title: Hold a ticket: keep possession
senses.definition: to have and keep something as yours
senses.definitionCN: 持有、保留（属于自己的东西）
senses.example: Hold on to your ticket until the end of the trip.
senses.exampleCN: 车票留到行程结束再扔。
senses.why: The hand keeps the object from leaving your possession. Holding is the state version of taking: what was taken stays taken.
senses.whyCN: 手让东西不离开你的所有范围。'持有'是 take 的状态版：拿到的东西继续留在手里。

senses.title: Hold office: occupy a position
senses.definition: to have a job, a position, or a record
senses.example: She holds the world record in swimming.
senses.exampleCN: 她保持着游泳世界纪录。
senses.why: A position is imagined as a place; holding it means your grip keeps you in that place. Possession becomes occupation.
senses.whyCN: 职位被想象成一个位置；'握'住它就等于让自己留在这个位置上。'拥有'于是变成'占据'。

senses.title: Hold a meeting: carry on
senses.definition: to organize and carry on an event such as a meeting or ceremony
senses.definitionCN: 举行、进行（会议、仪式等活动）
senses.example: We hold a team meeting every Monday.
senses.why: This comes from the older sense 'maintain, carry on': the event is kept in existence for its duration. The frame here is made of time.
senses.whyCN: 这来自更早的'维持、进行'义：活动在被'保持存在'的这段时间里持续进行。这里的'框'是时间做成的。

senses.title: Hold an opinion: believe
senses.definition: to have a belief or opinion
senses.example: He holds strong views about education.
senses.exampleCN: 他对教育有很坚定的看法。
senses.why: An idea is grasped mentally and not released: you keep it in mind, so you 'hold' it. Mental holding mirrors manual holding.
senses.whyCN: 一个想法被心智抓住、不放掉：你把它留在心里，所以说你'持有'它。心智的握，是手的握的镜像。

senses.title: The rule still holds: remain valid
senses.exampleCN: 那个论点已经站不住了。
senses.why: An argument or rule is a structure that must keep its shape under pressure. If it neither breaks nor slips, it holds — validity is stability.
senses.whyCN: 论点或规则是一个要在压力下保持形状的结构。如果它没断、没滑，它就'握得住'——'有效'就是稳定。

intro.en: hold is a native English strong verb with a Germanic family behind it. Its oldest recorded sense was probably not 'grasp' but 'tend, watch over'.
intro.cn: hold 是英语本族语的强动词，背后是一整个日耳曼词族。它最早被记录的义项也许不是'握'，而是'照料、看守'。

items.en: West Saxon healdan, Anglian haldan, meant 'to contain, grasp, retain; to observe or fulfil a custom; to possess, control, rule; to detain; to foster, cherish, keep watch over'. It was a class VII strong verb: past tense heold, past participle healden.
items.cn: 西撒克逊方言作 healdan，盎格利亚方言作 haldan，意为'容纳、握住、保留；遵守并履行习俗；拥有、控制、统治；扣留；养育、珍视、看守'。它是第七类强动词：过去式 heold，过去分词 healden。

items.en: The ancestor is *haldanan, shared with Old Saxon haldan, Old Frisian halda, Old Norse halda, Dutch houden, German halten and Gothic haldan 'to tend'.
items.cn: 祖词是原始日耳曼语 *haldanan，古撒克逊语 haldan、古弗里斯语 halda、古诺斯语 halda、荷兰语 houden、德语 halten 和哥特语 haldan'照料'都同出一源。

items.en: On the evidence of Gothic and a secondary Old English sense, OED calls it 'generally accepted' that the verb first meant 'to keep, tend, watch over' — as with grazing cattle — and only later widened to 'have as one's own'. The sense of looking survives in behold.
items.cn: 根据哥特语和古英语中的一个次要义项，OED 认为'普遍接受'的看法是：这个动词最初意为'看守、照料、看护'——比如看牛吃草——后来才扩展为'归自己所有'。'看'这一层意思还留在 behold 里。

items.en: Latin tenere 'to hold' (stem ten-/tain-) built a parallel family: contain, retain, maintain, detain, tenant. It is a separate borrowing, not a cognate. The old past participle holden was replaced by held in the 16th century but survives in beholden and in some legal wording.
items.cn: 拉丁语 tenere'握住'（词干 ten-/tain-）另造出了一族词：contain、retain、maintain、detain、tenant。这是另一条借入路径，不是同源词。旧的过去分词 holden 在 16 世纪被 held 取代，但仍活在 beholden 和某些法律用语里。

items.en: Modern English has hold – held – held. The noun hold is older than it looks: c. 1100 'act of holding', c. 1200 'a grip or support', and from the 1950s 'a waiting state' in telephony. The ship's hold is a different word, a 15th-century alteration of holl 'hull, hollow place'.
items.cn: 现代英语的变化是 hold – held – held。名词 hold 比看上去更古老：约 1100 年指'握的行为'，约 1200 年指'可抓握的支撑物'，20 世纪 50 年代起又指电话中的'等待接通状态'。船舱的 hold 是另一个词，是 15 世纪对 holl（'船壳、空腔'）的改写。

note.en: Words below can be confused with hold. Sound and spelling come first, meaning second.
note.cn: 下面这些词容易和 hold 混淆。先讲读音和拼写，再讲意思。

entries.definition: the past tense of hole, meaning 'made a hole in' or 'hit a ball into a hole'. It sounds exactly like hold; only the -ed tells them apart on paper.
entries.definitionCN: hole（打洞；把球打进洞）的过去式。读音和 hold 完全相同，纸面上只能靠 -ed 分辨。

entries.definition: an opening or a hollow space. It lacks the final /d/, so the tongue stops earlier.
entries.definitionCN: 洞；孔。少了结尾的 /d/，舌头停得更早。

entries.definition: brave, or strong and clear in appearance. Same -old ending, but b- instead of h-.
entries.definitionCN: 大胆的；醒目的。同样是 -old 结尾，但开头是 b- 不是 h-。

entries.definition: the past tense of tell. Same rhyme and ending; the meaning is speaking, not holding.
entries.definitionCN: tell 的过去式。押韵、结尾相同，但意思是'告诉'，不是'握住'。

entries.definition: This is hold's own past tense and past participle, not another word. It looks like hold but has a short /e/ and no o.
entries.definitionCN: 这就是 hold 自己的过去式和过去分词，不是另一个词。它长得像 hold，但元音是短音 /e/，而且没有 o。

entries.definition: having lived a long time. It is hold with the h removed, and the meaning is age, not grip.
entries.definitionCN: 年老的；旧的。就是去掉 h 的 hold，意思是年龄，不是握。

entries.definition: a yellow precious metal. Same -old ending, but starts with g- and is a noun.
entries.definitionCN: 黄金。同样是 -old 结尾，但开头是 g-，而且是名词。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real compounds and real phrases, each explaining one part of hold.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的复合词和真实短语，每一个都解释 hold 的某一面。

normal.en: hold the door — your hand is the frame that keeps the door in place, replacing the hinge for a moment.
normal.cn: hold the door —— 你的手就是让门留在原位的'框'，暂时替代了铰链。

normal.en: hold a meeting — from the older sense 'carry on, maintain': the meeting is kept in existence for its length.
normal.cn: hold a meeting —— 来自更早的'进行、维持'义：会议被'保持存在'一段时间。

normal.en: hold water — an argument that holds water keeps its shape under testing, so it remains valid.
normal.cn: hold water —— 站得住脚的论点在检验下能保持形状，所以它是有效的。

normal.en: withhold = with (away, back) + hold. To withhold is to hold something back from the person who should get it.
normal.cn: withhold = with（离开、往回）+ hold。'扣留'就是把本该给别人的东西握回去、不给出去。

normal.en: household = house + hold, where hold had a Middle English sense 'dwelling, habitation' — the people and things of one dwelling.
normal.cn: household = house + hold，这里的 hold 在中古英语里有'住所、居所'的意思，即同一处住所里的人与物。

abstract.en: Abstractly, hold is a frame drawn around a thing: the frame stops the thing from leaving. No force is needed; what matters is staying. Symbol: [ ● ]
abstract.cn: 抽象地看，hold 是在东西周围画出的一个'框'：框让东西离不开。它不需要用力，关键是'留住'。符号：[ ● ]

abstract.en: The frame can be made of different materials — a hand, a wall, a law, a stare. That is why one verb covers grip, containment, custody and attention. Symbol: [ ● ] with thicker walls.
abstract.cn: 这个框可以用不同材料做成——一只手、一堵墙、一条法律、一道目光。所以同一个动词能覆盖握、容纳、扣留和注视。符号：[ ● ]，只是框壁更厚。

abstract.en: The frame can also be turned inward: what you hold in mind is what you refuse to release — an opinion, a secret, a memory. Symbol: [ ● ] where the dot is an idea.
abstract.cn: 这个框也可以向内转：你在心里'握'住的东西，就是你拒绝放手的——一个观点、一个秘密、一段记忆。符号：[ ● ]，只是框里的点变成了想法。

examples.en: Can you hold the door for me?
This jug holds two litres of milk.
examples.cn: 这个罐子能装两升牛奶。

examples.en: She held the umbrella against the wind.

dict_mnemonic.text: 厚的手掌（hold）—— 手掌够厚，才握得住、托得稳 → hold

root: 源自古英语 healdan（握住、看守），与德语 halten 同源。

sensesIntro.en: Ten common senses of hold. All of them use one shape: something is put inside a frame and kept from leaving.
sensesIntro.cn: hold 的十个常见义项。它们都共用同一个形状：把东西放进一个框里，让它离不开。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a frame — hand, wall, law, attention — around a thing, so it stays where it is.
core.cn: 核心意象：用手、墙、法律或注意力，在东西周围围出一个'框'，让它留在原处。

branches.en: PHYSICAL: the hand grasps or supports, and the frame fixes a position.
branches.cn: 物理层面：手握或托，框把位置固定住。

branches.en: ENCLOSURE: a vessel holds volume, a cell holds a person — capacity and custody are the same frame.
branches.cn: 围合：容器握住容积，牢房握住人——容量和扣留是同一个框。

branches.en: RESISTANCE: the frame pushes back against movement — hold back a crowd, hold back tears.
branches.cn: 抵抗：框逆着运动方向推回去——拦住人群、忍住眼泪。

branches.en: OWNERSHIP: what stays in your grip is yours; a position held is a place occupied.
branches.cn: 归属：留在你握中的东西归你；被握住的职位就是一个被占据的位置。

branches.en: CONTINUITY: events, opinions and rules are held — kept in existence, kept in mind, kept valid.
branches.cn: 延续：活动、观点和规则被'握住'——保持存在、保持在心里、保持有效。

intro.en: hold combines with particles and prefixes that shift the frame: upward, backward, outward, or around a whole house.
intro.cn: hold 与小品词和前缀组合，改变'框'的方向：向上、向后、向外，或者围住整个家。

latinIntro.en: Latin tenere 'to hold' (stem ten-/tain-) produced a large English family: contain, retain, maintain, detain, tenant. It is a separate borrowing with the same core meaning, not a cognate of hold.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 tenere'握住'（词干 ten-/tain-）在英语里造出了一个大家族：contain、retain、maintain、detain、tenant。这是另一条借入路径，核心意思相同，但不是 hold 的同源词。

items.meaning: a person who holds something, or an object made to hold something
items.meaningCN: 持有者；支架、容器（-er 表示做这个动作的人或物）
items.example: Put the pen back in its holder.

items.meaning: the act of holding; shares or property that someone owns
items.meaningCN: 持有；股份、资产（-ing 把动作变成名词）
items.example: She has a large holding in the company.
items.exampleCN: 她持有这家公司大量股份。

items.meaning: to support or confirm a law, decision, or principle
items.meaningCN: 支持、维护（法律、裁决、原则）（up- 表示'向上托住'）
items.example: The court upheld the original decision.

items.meaning: to keep something back and refuse to give it
items.meaningCN: 扣留；拒绝给予（with- 表示'往回、离开'）
items.example: The company withheld his pay for a week.
items.exampleCN: 公司扣了他的工资一周。

items.meaning: all the people living together in one house; the home as a unit
items.meaningCN: 一家人；家庭（hold 在中古英语里指'住所'）
items.example: The whole household shares the chores.

items.meaning: a place where your foot can rest; a small position from which to advance
items.example: The climbers found a foothold on the rock.
items.exampleCN: 攀登者在岩壁上找到了一个落脚点。

latinEntries.meaning: to keep something and not lose it
to hold something inside; to have within itself
to keep something in good condition; to keep a claim standing
to keep someone from leaving; to delay
